title_he: בְּחָכְמָה אַתָּה לְבַדְּךָ אוֹחֵז מֶתֶג הַדָּבָר
review: The hymn is providence: 1:1–8 is Ps 104:24 with Job 12:10 and Ps 115:3, 2:1–8 is Ps 145:9 with Ps 91:1 and Ps 23:4, 3:1–8 is Rom 8:28 with Prov 16:33 and Ps 139:16, and 4:1–8 is Ps 119:18 with Eph 1:11 and Ps 19:9.

1:2 אוֹחֵז מֶתֶג — the Arabic مَاسِك زِمَام الأمر is 'holding the rein of the matter'; the Hebrew uses מֶתֶג, the bridle of Ps 32:9 and 2 Kgs 19:28, so the line is the hand on the reins and not a general 'controls'.

3:5–6 keep the print's two claims (the details are with You; You reckon them precisely) on two lines, with דַּיְקָנוּת as a post-biblical noun for precision because the line must name exactness and not merely care.
